title: Desk Guidance — Dose Number of a Posted Immunization Services Dose
content:
**The posted dose takes the dose number one past the dose entries on the course.**

This is the rule the Patient Care Desk applies when an Immunization Services dose given at a Kestrel store is posted to a vaccination course after the visit.

## Terms

- **Dose entries on the course** — the dose-given entries already on the course history when the dose is posted, whichever provider each was recorded from. The dose being posted is not yet one of them.
- **Doses Kestrel gave on the course** — the dose entries that name a Kestrel store, that is every dose entry on the course less those recorded from another provider.
- **Printed dose number** — the dose number printed on the appointment or on the screening and consent form. The dose number printed on the appointment or the form is the booking system's own count and is not the number the posted dose takes.

## The rule restated

| Input | Where it is read | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Number of dose entries on the course | The course history, before the posting | The posted dose number is that count plus one |
| Number printed on the appointment or form | The appointment or form | Not used for the posted dose number |

In words: count the dose entries the course history already holds; the posted dose is numbered one past that count.

## Worked examples (hypothetical)

*Hypothetical course A.* The course history holds two dose entries. The posted dose takes dose number 3, one past two.

*Hypothetical course B.* The course history holds no dose entry, and the appointment prints dose 2. The posted dose takes dose number 1, one past none; the printed 2 is the booking system's own count.

*Hypothetical course C.* The course history holds one dose entry recorded from another provider and one entry naming a Kestrel store. Both are dose entries on the course, so the posted dose takes dose number 3; of the two, one is a dose Kestrel gave on the course.
